s00_wake: You wake up. You look in the mirror.
s00_title: What if you were Ken in Ershui?
s00_week: It's a new week. After school, you have free time!
s01_ask: Today is Monday. School is over. It's rainy. Time to go home. It's four ten. What do you do in your free time?
s01_ken: I study English in my free time.
s01_link: You read your English book. There's a quiz tomorrow!
s02_ask: It's Monday evening. It's rainy outside. It's seven thirty. What do you do in your free time?
s02_ken: I watch TV in my free time.
s02_link: You sit on the sofa with Mom. Ha ha! The show is so funny.
s03_ask: Today is Tuesday. It's a cool, sunny morning. Time to go to school. It's seven o'clock. What do you do in your free time?
s03_ken: I go jogging in my free time.
s03_link: You put on your running shoes. You jog to school. Good morning, school!
s04_ask: It's Tuesday afternoon. School is over. It's very hot. It's four twenty. What do you do in your free time?
s04_ken: I listen to music in my free time.
s04_link: You go to the library. It's cool inside. You put on your new headphones.
s05_ask: It's Tuesday evening. Time to go home. It's six fifteen. What do you do in your free time?
s05_ken: I play the recorder in my free time.
s05_link: Mom picks you up at the library. At home, you play a song. Toot, toot!
s06_ask: It's Wednesday evening. It's cloudy and cold. It's eight o'clock. What do you do in your free time?
s06_ken: I play online games in my free time.
s06_link: You put on your headset. You play with Tom. You win!
s07_ask: Today is Thursday. It's rainy after school. It's four forty. What do you do in your free time?
s07_ken: I surf the Internet in my free time.
s07_link: You look for photos of Ershui. Your report looks great!
s08_ask: Today is Saturday. It's sunny and windy. It's nine thirty. What do you do in your free time?
s08_ken: I ride a bike in my free time.
s08_link: Your bike is fixed! You ride to Ershui Elementary School. Your friends are there.
s09_ask: It's Saturday afternoon. It's sunny. It's two fifty. What do you do in your free time?
s09_ken: I play basketball in my free time.
s09_link: You and your friends ride to the big lawn. Shoot! Score!
s10_ask: It's Saturday evening. The sky is clear. It's six forty. What do you do in your free time?
s10_ken: I go camping in my free time.
s10_link: Mom and Dad come to the lawn. You put up a tent. Look at all the stars!
s11_ask: Today is Sunday. It's a sunny morning. It's eight forty. What do you do in your free time?
s11_ken: I play baseball in my free time.
s11_link: Dad throws the ball. You hit it. Home run!
s12_week: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Saturday, Sunday. What a free week!
s12_end: So, what if YOU were Ken in Ershui?
s12_you: What do YOU do in your free time?
